description: Figures a household's ACA marketplace premium tax credit position from its state, the ages on the plan, household size and income. For 2026 coverage: the credit (Form 8962 line 24, computed by QuantCalc's federal tax API) at the state-level or a given benchmark premium, the poverty line and percentage, the expected contribution, the Medicaid and coverage-gap regimes, the 400% cliff income, the headroom below it, and the credit lost by being $1 over it; needs a connected QuantCalc PRO licence or Tax Season Pass. For 2027 coverage: the county's benchmark premium from CMS's plan-year-2027 files (or a given one), the poverty line (2026 HHS guidelines), the 400% cliff and the headroom, and with a connected licence the 2027 credit (Form 8962 for coverage year 2027 from the federal tax API, Rev. Proc. 2026-26's percentages) and the credit lost by being $1 over the cliff; without a licence the 2027 credit is not figured and the free page that figures it is named. Not tax advice.

ages.description: The ages of the people on the marketplace plan. Ages 21-64 are priced; 65 and over (Medicare) and under 21 are not.

benchmark_monthly.description: The household's own monthly benchmark (second-lowest-cost silver) premium for the people on the plan, from healthcare.gov or the state's marketplace. Default: 2026, the state-level benchmark at each age; 2027, the county's CMS figure; stated in the result.

county.description: 2027 only: the county (name, e.g. Miami-Dade, or 5-digit FIPS code) whose CMS plan-year-2027 benchmark premium is read; published for the HealthCare.gov states. Default: none, stated in the result.

coverage_year.description: The coverage year: 2026 (the premium tax credit from QuantCalc's federal tax API, Form 8962; needs a licence) or 2027 (open enrollment now: the CMS county benchmark, the poverty line, the 400% cliff and the headroom from published data, and with a licence the 2027 credit from the API).

filing_status.description: 2026 only: the filing status of the return the credit is claimed on (married filing separately generally gets no credit). Default: single for a household of 1, else married filing jointly, stated in the result.

household_size.description: Tax family size for the poverty line (the filer, a spouse on a joint return, dependents). Default: the number of ages given, stated in the result.

income.description: The household's modified AGI for the credit: AGI plus tax-exempt interest plus the Social Security not taxed, for the coverage year.

state.description: Two-letter state of residence, or DC.

name: aca_premium_tax_credit
title: ACA premium tax credit, benchmark and the 400% cliff
